scientific_integrity: The theorem proves exact moment identities for explicitly defined stationary environments; all forward Gaussian/Markov transform foundations are attributed. Analytic positivity and uniqueness are not based on finite tests.
scientific_limitations: Requires equilibrium initial environments, independent tracer Brownian drivers, fixed positive finite mean/correlation rate, and strictly positive two-state diffusivities. Describes population cumulants, not noisy statistical estimation or equality of complete tracer distributions. Unindexed equivalent mathematical literature remains possible.
title: A unique sixth-cumulant crossing and strict eighth-order separation of covariance-matched random diffusivities
